conclusion: The n=5 and n=8 scalar optima are unrealizable by exact census. On all 946 exact n=5,8 optima and the known larger feasible witnesses, ordered port partitions compress to at most four repeated components, three cyclic runs per component, and nine compressed runs; proving these bounds for all extremal patterns is the remaining annulus-state coverage problem.
